GDD §10 DIFFICULTY CURVE — 1.4.0 MEASURED (draft by P1M; P10 folds it into docs/GDD.md §10 "Targets" and the assist
paragraph, replacing P1's "minShare 0 until P1M measures it" and the "Open for P1M" note in build/P1/docs/GDD-10-curve.txt)
=====================================================================================================================

VALUES P1M CHANGED (js/data.js, values only)
- LEAK_BANDS L46-60: 0.29-0.33 -> 0.28-0.32 (the pre-registered skilled-bot knob: 69 of 96 clears at the old band, under 70).
  L61-120 keeps 0.29-0.33, so the band still steps up by 0.01 at L61.
- LEVELS.curve.assist.minTravelM: 2 m -> 1 m. A gate event counts as a decision when the steering target travels at least 1 m
  (or changes lane) while that event is the active one. At 2 m the counter credited only 74 % (decent) and 81 % (skilled) of
  the failed runs of players who were steering; at 1 m 100 % and 99 %. A hands-off run still counts 0, a single swipe 1.
- LEVELS.curve.assist.minShare: 0 -> 0.32. A failed run joins the REINFORCEMENTS streak only with counted decisions
  >= max(3, ceil(0.32 x gate events reached)). 0.32 is half the decent bot's 10th-percentile share (0.643 at 1 m), per D48.
  A player who swipes three times and then leaves the game running no longer qualifies once the run reaches 10 or more gate
  events (it still does on shorter runs).
Text for §10 F (assist): "A failed run joins the streak with at least max(3, 32 % of the gate events it reached) counted
decisions; an event counts once, when the steering target moved at least 1 m or changed lane while that gate was the next
one. Leaving the game running counts nothing and neither adds to nor resets the streak."

tester ranks to L30, rank 10 after; pass counts fixed before the first run). All rows at the final values.

Owner path (rank 10, reported): L7 hands-off clears 3 of 24 attempts, 1 inside the real 4-attempt sequence (held right,

12 of 24 (unchanged by P1M; P1's pre-registered L5 rule kept V0) — Q-L5.

METHOD NOTE (for the balance appendix)
- The built-in skilled bot of the frozen harness kept its boss-dodge state from one run into the next. After a run that
  ended mid-dodge, the next run held the road centre for up to the whole level. P1M measured every skilled-bot row with that
  state reset before each run (harness/p1m/botreset.js; a steward fix to harness.js is requested). F12's and P1's skilled
  rows were measured with the leak, so their skilled numbers read low (L46-60: 63 vs 69 of 96 at the same values).
